title: Period Halved by an Interior Coefficient
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Identify the amplitude and period of $y=\sin 2x$ and describe how the factor $2$ reshapes the usual sine wave.

steps.title: Match the Standard Form
steps.explanation: No multiplier stands outside, so $A=1$; the argument $2x$ gives $B=2$.
steps.why: Coefficients outside the sine control height while coefficients inside control speed.

steps.title: Record the Amplitude
steps.explanation: The peaks and troughs stay at $\pm 1$; the vertical size is unchanged from the parent sine.
steps.why: Amplitude depends only on the outer multiplier.

steps.title: Compute the Compressed Period
steps.explanation: The argument runs at double speed, so a full cycle completes in $\pi$ instead of $2\pi$.
steps.why: Doubling $B$ squeezes the wave horizontally by a factor of two.
